children: Airbnb
is expanding access to OpenAI's
frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra, for its engineering and product development teams under a new agreement, the companies said on Wednesday.
The expansion builds on Airbnb's use of OpenAI's
Codex and its existing collaboration with the artificial intelligence company. Airbnb
engineers use an internal AI assistant to write software and create remote AI agents powered by Codex and OpenAI models.
Under the agreement, Airbnb
will access OpenAI
models through OpenAI APIs and Amazon Bedrock, the companies said.
Airbnb

said early use of GPT-6 Astra has helped engineers investigate difficult software bugs, develop system designs, and explore engineering approaches. In one test involving strategic documents and other non-coding work, an Airbnb
user reached the desired output in three to four passes, compared with more than 20 rounds using other models, the company said.
"Our development teams are shipping roughly 80% more features than a year ago," Airbnb
Chief Technology Officer Ahmad Al-Dahle said, adding that OpenAI's
frontier models are a key part of its developer tooling.
OpenAI
Chief Revenue Officer Dali Rajic said the expanded access would give Airbnb
teams more tools to move ideas into production.
Airbnb also uses OpenAI
models in areas including search, fraud prevention, guest and host support, and insurance claims, according to the release.

title: Airbnb broadens use of OpenAI models across engineering teams
